_readme: Wisdom Loop Discord sources (§2.1). IDs only — no message text, no member data.
Guild channel IDs resolved 2026-09-13 via GET /guilds/{guild}/channels with the UCT Intelligence bot token (app 1474900505917653142, role 1474903498700230668).

access = the bot's measured result of GET /channels/{id}/messages?limit=1 after the grant (200 = readable). Grants were made in the Discord web UI as a channel permission override on the bot role; required bits were computed from the channel's @everyone overwrite (see grant_bits).
Only messages whose author_id is in docs/wisdom/authors.json are stored; everything else is dropped before any write (§0.4e).

channels.name: main-chat
channels.note: General community chat, NOT author-specific. Measured 2026-09-19: 17 distinct posters in the last 100 messages, only 1 (braczyy/Bracco) is a named CALL author. Under the current author_id-in-authors.json storage filter (S0.4e), scoping this in captures only that author's own posts here -- everything else is dropped before any write, by design. Broadening capture to other members' posts (as MENTION-only, non-CALL content) is a separate, not-yet-built decision the owner has not yet ruled on -- see docs/wisdom/HARD-RULES.md Session 28 note.

Not authored by the four. Relevant to CALL-REPLAY only through the dashboard's own scan stores, never through Discord.

channels.name: kicker-candle
channels.note: One of 18 SETUP EXAMPLES channels (category 1443971380289994934), added 2026-09-19 per owner request. NOT author-specific -- same S0.4e capture-scope question as main-chat applies here, and more sharply: these channels exist specifically for community members to post real setup examples, so a strict author-only filter would likely capture almost nothing. Needs both (1) a bot grant and (2) the owner's ruling on broadened, non-author capture before it's worth polling.
